text.tspan: derived-credit
The source claim clears pending before vector fetch;
a later publication belongs to a new claim epoch
native-target
Select VM0 processor0 at native callback acceptance
under lifecycle lease; no kernel-origin generation
inference
vector-fetch
Fetch vector after claim; root selected procedure;
later replacement does not rewrite that reference
storage-commit
Pending and active target-bound work retain old VM;
root lease and native retirement receipts required
mailbox
Mailbox is wake hint; authoritative target/claim-
epoch pending state survives drain; never merge
across claim
thread-route
Current thread invokes directly; absent current
thread queues primordial thunk; preserve terminated-
target exceptions
dynamic-handler
Read dynamic user handler when thunk executes;
custom vector procedures and exceptions require
separate semantic refinement
deferred-user
Deferred-user pending bit and setter-filter replay
are separate from native pending; clear before
calling supplied procedure

g.text: SysML -> ASCENT -> QNT / Lean; source + platform OPEN

text.tspan: coalescing
Compared with current flag path no callback-count
saving is established; merging across claim is
forbidden
wake
Only wake hints merge; no SIGINT delivery or user
callback may be inferred completed from exchange
retirement
Old VM must remain serviceable until accepted work and
roots settle; no bounded shutdown guarantee
language
Zig does not remove these semantic obligations;
additional language benefit remains unproved
